description.value: Crispy Delight is a Persian-style pizza and sub restaurant located on Marine Drive in North Vancouver, specializing in a unique fusion of Persian-inspired spices and traditional pizza craftsmanship. The menu highlights include Persian pizza with fresh dough prepared daily, Bandari Sausage inspired by southern Iranian coastal flavors, and a range of hot and cold subs. The cozy dine-in space and online ordering for pickup and delivery make it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area.
